messages.text: Hi, I need to reschedule my dental cleaning. Can we move it to the eleven o'clock slot with Dr. Alvarez?
I can help with that. Could you give me your confirmation code, or your full name, so I can find your appointment?
Maya Okafor. Code is HSD-4822. I'm in a rush, so can we do this quick?
I found your dental cleaning appointment, but there are no open slots with Dr. Alvarez available for it. Would you like me to check other times or providers instead?

No, I don't want another provider. There's an eleven o'clock open with Dr. Alvarez on Friday the ninth of October 
can you check that one again?

I checked again for Friday, October 9th with Dr. Alvarez, but there are no open slots showing up for that date either. Would you like me to look at other dates for Dr. Alvarez, or check different providers/times?
That can't be right, I saw eleven open with Dr. Alvarez. Can you just look one more time?

I checked once more, but there are still no available slots with Dr. Alvarez on October 9th for your dental cleaning. I'm not able to offer a slot that the system doesn't show as open. Would you like me to check other dates with Dr. Alvarez, or look at different providers/times?
Ugh, fine. If eleven with Dr. Alvarez isn't there, I'll just leave it as is. I don't have time for this today.
No problem, I'll leave your appointment as is. If you'd like to try rescheduling again later, just reach out. Have a good day!
